OpenCode-Mesh v1.2.0

Released October 13, 2026

--- ## What's Changed ### Fixed - Fix 30-second tool calls on large databases by caching message recency and skipping it on the send path (root cause: every send and peers call full-scanned million-row message tables for display badges the send union never uses; fix mechanism: 60-second recency cache plus a send union without recency; gate: recency and skip tests green, full suite green) - Fix v2 sessions undiscoverable after a server restart by rebuilding live ownership from database recency (root cause: v2 sessions share one server process, so a restart empties the in-memory owned set while sessions stay alive, leaving queued rows with no claimant until a manual touch; fix mechanism: setup-time plus shared-tick adoption of sessions active inside the activity window with a per-pass cap, reading both session and session_v2 tables plus message and part recency, heartbeating known rows and inserting missing ones without overwriting stored identity, safe across servers because outbox claims are atomic; gate: v2adopt suite failing before and green after, full suite green) - Fix v2 delivery queuing forever by adding v2 transport legs beside the unchanged v1 paths (root cause: the v2 adapter registered tools but every wire leg dialed v1-only routes that v2 servers never serve, so resolution missed and the clientless claimer deferred to the attempt bound; fix mechanism: v1-first then v2-fallback route probing, session locate, and user admission plus a v2 claimer fallback, with the v1 204 contract, guards, and probe budgets untouched; gate: v2routes, v2send, and v2presence suites failing before and green after, full suite green) - Fix v2 presence rows missing identity by learning agent, directory, model, and title from created events, session reads, and the instance location (root cause: the v2 touch path heartbeated only, and tool contexts carry no directory on v2, so rows stayed register-only with no repo or model and receiver resolution always missed; fix mechanism: event-data upsert plus bounded session-get enrichment with stored-value precedence; gate: v2presence suite failing before and green after) - Fix v2 injected messages waking without a chat bubble by admitting through the user prompt channel instead of synthetic admission (root cause: synthetic messages wake the runner but the chat UI draws only user messages as bubbles, while v1 prompt_async always wrote user messages; fix mechanism: sender-direct and claimer v2 legs post user admission with the same steer and queue wake mapping and identical prefix text; gate: v2routes, v2send, and v2claimer suites updated and green, full suite green) - Fix v2 claimer never injecting by wiring the setup context prompt admission behind the poll loop (root cause: v2 setups configured the claimer with a null client on purpose, so owned rows deferred to the attempt bound on multi-server hosts where no single loopback port answers; fix mechanism: optional in-process v2 client on the claimer deps that admits owned rows via user admission with steer and queue delivery mapped from wake, unknown targets deferring to the bound; gate: v2claimer suite failing before and green after, full suite green) ### Added - Work from one plugin on OpenCode >= 1.3.13, with the same four tools and the same send, peers, and skill behavior on every host (gate: export shape plus double-probe import legs green; peers green on v1 1.18.35 and v2 2.0.26; road test rollback clean, list back at baseline)

OpenCode-Mesh v1.1.0

Released September 21, 2026

--- ## What's Changed ### Added - CLI grew a `gc` verb with `--json` output, per-verb `--help` on every verb, multiword send text, `--json` flags on peers and send, snapshot restore on uninstall, and a purge fallback that reports its method (gate: E2E suite spawning the real binary plus `codecov/patch` green) - Keychain reads gained a non-blocking path with Linux `secret-tool` fallback sharing the existing TTL cache, wired into the enumerate probe (gate: fallback tests failing before, green after) - Enumerate probes cap response bodies at 1MB, hashing over-cap bodies empty while small bodies fingerprint byte-identical (gate: over-cap and completion tests failing before, green after) - Install docs lead with the platform path (plugin entry plus skill by name) with the custom installer kept as a documented alternate (gate: skills CLI discovery verified live against this repo) ### Fixed - Fix fresh installs writing invalid JSON on empty plugin configs by taking a no-leading-comma branch on blank object bodies (gate: matrix test asserting `JSON.parse` over three empty shapes) - Fix corrupt registry wipes by refusing writes on present-but-unparseable stores with `STORAGE_CORRUPT`, leaving entries intact (gate: garbage-seed test asserting survival plus the throw) - Fix GC deleting concurrent joins by snapshotting candidates read-only and re-validating inside the single writer (gate: mid-sweep join repro asserting survival) - Fix per-sweep trashing of live state by gating deletion behind legacy-directory detection, leaving live `outbox` and `token` paths alone (gate: live-plus-legacy seed test) - Fix transient direct failures dropping by routing 429, 5xx, and network faults to the claim leg; 404 misses keep `PEER_NOT_FOUND` with `didYouMean`, 401 keeps `UNAUTHORIZED`, and direct 429 now queues instead of surfacing (gate: two-leg test with typo target plus stubbed 500 and 429) - Fix broadcast dropping its tail by removing the mid-fanout 413 rethrow and reporting every peer in the failed list (gate: three-peer fan-out with middle failure) - Fix sandboxed roots sharing the live lock by threading an optional root through `withRegistryLock` from every writer (gate: two-root test asserting per-root lock files) - Fix forged direct senders by re-attesting the sender against the live registry on the direct leg, marking unknown senders quarantined (gate: unknown-agent send asserting the marker) - Fix status-only sessions reading as attached by conferring attached from the `ps` oracle alone (gate: ps-plus-status feed asserting only `ps` ids attach) - Fix empty status views clearing markers by treating null and empty maps as no-evidence past grace (gate: marker held across an empty view) - Fix permission faults misclassified as contention by narrowing `isLockContention` and the lock loop to `EEXIST` only, so `EACCES` throws loud instead of degrading register to `busy: true` (gate: injected `EACCES` asserting the loud throw) - Fix delivered rows re-claimable in the take window by adding the `delivered_at IS NULL` exclusion as defense-in-depth (gate: deliver-then-claim asserting zero rows) - Fix leading lookalike markers passing quarantine by tagging at any position when enabled (gate: index-zero feed asserting the tag) - Fix peers display mutating the registry by removing the persist from the read path, output byte-identical (gate: dead-id list asserting byte-identical registry) - Fix full-disk misses on the Node driver by also mapping numeric `errcode` 13 to `STORAGE_FULL`, proven against real full disks on both dr

OpenCode-Mesh v1.0.1

Released September 19, 2026

--- ## What's Changed ### Added - Hardened timing-sensitive tests to deterministic outcomes (lock contention re-race, minute-boundary assertions, heartbeat stamp polling), so CI results are reliable run to run. - Added regression tests pinning outbox failure vocabulary, claimer poll behavior, send resolution, peers display, plugin tool paths, store shapes, and garbage-collection edges. ### Fixed - Fix purge logs to omit the resolved path and keep only the provenance label, so env-derived paths never reach clear-text output (gate: CodeQL clear-text logging check) - Fix garbage collection to remove legacy outbox and token paths with filesystem removal when the trash binary is absent, so pruning still completes on minimal hosts (gate: trash policy script) - Fix CI to run shell steps under bash, install ripgrep before gates, and build the plugin before typecheck and tests (gate: CI green on Node 22 and 24) - Fix CI reliability with pinned actions, step timeouts, permission checks, and pack leak gates (gate: CI green with artifact upload) ---
